subject: Request: Pilot extension & sandbox credits due to SSO integration failure
messages:
From: Evan Ross <evan.ross@verapay.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot blocked by SSO - asking for short extension + sandbox credits

Hi Lauren / Priyom,

Quick note from our side — we’ve hit a hard stop on SSO (SAML handshake failing intermittently) while wiring Redwood into our staging environment. Our engineering team traced it to a token refresh edge-case that only shows up with our IdP (PingFederate). We opened a ticket with your support team (ref #7432) and attached the server-side error log for context.

This blocks our ability to run the headless connector test for the pilot; without the SSO fix we can’t finish the integration and the demo window scheduled for Dec 2 will be missed.

Two asks:
- Short pilot extension of 30 days so we can finish testing once the SSO patch lands;
- A small sandbox credit top-up (~100k tokens) so our engineers can re-run the end-to-end tests without hitting quotas while we iterate.

We want to stay on track for the Q1 procurement review; otherwise we’ll need to push the internal sign-off by a month. Appreciate quick help here.

Attached: sso-error-log.txt and the support ticket PDF.

Thanks,
Evan Ross
Director of Platform Integrations, VeraPay
evan.ross@verapay.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@verapay.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by SSO - asking for short extension + sandbox credits

Hi Evan — thanks for the detail and the error logs. Sorry you’re running into this mid-pilot. I’ve looped in Priyom (solutions) and will escalate to our leadership team for a quick decision on extension + credits.

Short note on next steps from our side:
1) Priyom — can you do a quick triage and confirm estimated fix time and whether the workaround (disabling token refresh) is safe for VeraPay’s staging environment?
2) I’ll request an exception for credits and a 30-day keepalive for the pilot with the revenue ops folks; will surface any constraints.

Evan — I’ll get back to you within 48 hours with a firm answer. Would you be available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on acceptance tests and rollback criteria?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: VeraPay request - pilot extension + 100k tokens (SSO blocker)

Vivek / Priyom — quick internal ask.

Summary: VeraPay (DP-4821) hit an SSO token refresh failure with PingFederate; support ticket #7432 attached. Customer requests a 30-day pilot extension and ~100k token sandbox top-up so their engineers can re-run full E2E without quota interference. Demo window is at risk (Dec 2).

Priyom — triage suggests this is an IdP-specific refresh timing issue; likely patchable by our runtime team with a configuration tweak. Estimate: 2-3 dev-hours + 1 staging deploy if we prioritize.

Recommendation for authorization:
- Approve a capped 21-day extension (conditional on a weekly progress check-in) — reduces runway risk while keeping a hard end date;
- Approve 75k token sandbox credit (one-time) — enough for 2 full test passes based on their usage pattern;
- Require a post-mortem and the fix deployed to staging within 7 business days;
- Attach support SLA of 2 prioritized support hours (office-hours) to help them validate once patch is live.

Financial impact: ~$180 in marginal hosting cost; long-term ARR from VeraPay looks promising (mid-six-figure). My ask: your sign-off for the conditional approach above so I can respond to Evan and get the demo back on calendar.

Thanks,
Lauren
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: VeraPay request - pilot extension + 100k tokens (SSO blocker)

Thanks Lauren — agree with the conditional route. Approve the following:
- 21-day pilot extension starting from 2026-11-22;
- 75,000 token sandbox credit (one-time allocation);
- 2 office-hours of prioritized support from Solutions (Priyom to schedule);
- Require a staging deployment and short test run within 7 business days or we rescind the extension.

Priyom — please coordinate with Support to book the 2 office-hours and update support ticket #7432 with a remediation ETA.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@verapay.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by SSO - asking for short extension + sandbox credits (APPROVED)

Hi Evan — good news. We approved a conditional extension and a one-time sandbox top-up to keep your pilot moving:

What we approved:
- 21-day pilot keepalive, effective 2026-11-22 (new demo window must be within that period);
- 75,000 token sandbox credit (one-time) added to VeraPay staging account;
- 2 prioritized office-hours of solutions support to validate once your IdP patch is applied.

Conditions:
- We require a staging deploy and a short test run within 7 business days of today;
- Weekly 30-minute stand-up with Priyom to track progress until completion;
- If the staging deploy doesn’t happen within 7 business days, the extension will be rescinded.

I’ve attached the support ticket link and the error logs we received. Priyom will reach out to schedule the support hours and coordinate the fix.

Related links: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7432
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/67890/deal/DP-4821

Evan — are you available for a quick sync tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm acceptance tests and ownership for the staging deploy?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: support-ticket-#7432.pdf, sso-error-log.txt, verapay-moa-draft.docx
